login.heading: Welcome back to TodoApp
login.body: Sign in to pick up right where you left off. Your tasks are waiting.

signup.heading: Create your free account
signup.body: Join TodoApp and start organizing your day in seconds. Your tasks, your way — always private, always yours.

login-form: Email address — the address you registered with
Forgot your password? Reset it via email
sign-up-link: No credit card required — sign up in under 30 seconds
Your tasks are private and scoped only to your account
signup-form: Email address — your unique login identifier, e.g. you@example.com
Password — at least 8 characters, mix of letters and numbers recommended
Confirm password — re-enter your password to make sure it matches
Create account — submits the form, validates all fields, and redirects you to your personal dashboard on success
Inline error messages appear immediately if an email is already in use or passwords do not match
header-nav: Greeting: 'Good morning, {userName}' — displayed in muted-foreground beside the logo
Logout button — top-right corner, secondary variant, triggers session sign-out and redirects to /login
task-input: Text input — full-width, placeholder: 'e.g. Review Q3 budget report…', auto-focused on page load
Add Task button — primary variant, indigo background, disabled while input is empty or request is in flight
Inline loading spinner replaces button label while the task is being saved
Keyboard shortcut: pressing Enter inside the input submits the form
task-list: Task row — indigo checkbox on the left toggles is_complete; checked state applies line-through styling to the title
Task title — body text, foreground color when active, muted-foreground with strikethrough when complete
Delete button — danger icon button (trash icon) on the far right; shows a loading spinner while the delete request is pending
Row hover — accent tint (#e0e7ff) background transition on hover for clear interactivity feedback
Tasks sorted by created_at descending — newest tasks appear at the top of the list
Completed tasks sorted below active tasks within the same list — no separate tab needed
Each task card has a subtle 1 px border and 8 px radius consistent with the design system
empty-state: Centered SVG illustration — a clean, minimal clipboard with a small checkmark, rendered in indigo and slate tones
Headline: 'You're all caught up!' — h2 weight, foreground color
Subtext: 'Add your first task above and start making progress — one step at a time.' — body size, muted-foreground
Visible only when the authenticated user's task list is empty (zero rows returned from DB)
logout: Logout action clears the NextAuth.js session cookie and invalidates the server-side session
User is redirected to /login immediately after sign-out completes
Logout button is always visible in the header — no hidden menus or extra confirmation step required
Session expiry: unauthenticated requests to /dashboard are automatically redirected to /login via middleware
